run_singlepoint_calculations: run singlepoint energy and force calculations on a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_properties_for_atoms: calculate energy forces or other properties for a subset of atomic structures split across parallel jobs
write_singlepoint_results: write singlepoint calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the specified results directory

review_singlepoint_runner_class: review the SinglePointRunner class and its calculate method for handling errors and saving target properties
